title: Meeting at the Busy Market
text: Mia: Hi, Ben! Where are you? Ben: I'm near the big market. There are many people here. Mia: Is there a coffee shop near you? Ben: Yes, there is. It's next to the bank. Mia: Good. I'm at the bus stop. I'm walking to the market now. Ben: OK. The market is between the bank and the library. Mia: I see a tall building. Is that the library? Ben: No, that's the hospital. The library is behind the market. Mia: Thanks. I'm coming. Wait for me near the coffee shop. Ben: Sure. I'm standing under the clock. Mia: Great. See you in five minutes.
